Method of Attack: Remote Access Trojan (RAT) with multi-layer obfuscation
Delivered via malspam campaign through malicious attachments or URL redirections to payloads
Multi-stage infection process using multi-nested JAR files to conceal malware
Steals sensitive info like VPN certificates and credentials from browsers (Chrome, Internet Explorer, Edge)
Records video and sound, takes webcam photos
Mines cryptocurrency and harvests crypto wallet info
Discoverer: Netskope information security researcher Abhinav Singh
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with malicious attachments or URL redirections
Indicators of Compromise: Malware sample hashes of various JAR payloads
IP addresses and domains of command and control (C2) and malware delivery servers
Final embedded DLL detected as Gen:Variant.Application.Agentus.1
Samples hosted on compromised Westnet user accounts
